event_name: FMP NHRA Arizona Nationals presented by NGK Spark Plugs

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 99 degrees, relative humidity 10 percent, barometer 29.69 inches, adjusted
altitude 4,341 feet, track temperature 137 degrees.

This is the 115th time that the #1 & 2 TF qualifiers have met in the Final round. The #1 qualifier has won 63
of those meetings.
 
Langdon is 17 - 8 against Pruett in prior events and each has won 1 times against the other in final rounds. 

Langdon with a tick advantage on the tree and never trailed for the win.  Langdon is the first Top Fuel driver
to win this event in three consecutive years.  He wins his 23rd National event Wally.
